title: 第22章 “你身上……怎么有一股让我作呕的味儿？
novel_title: 镇守魔教圣女？我一天涨一年功力
content_zh:
夜深人静，天牢狱卒休息室。

    昏黄的油灯摇曳，墙壁上映出陈然修长的影子。

    【坐镇天牢，获得一年功力。】

    熟悉的暖流在四肢百骸游走，汇入丹田。陈然没有在意这点蚊子腿，他从床榻底下抽出一把狱卒标配的精铁腰刀。

    昨日斩杀那名黑衣刺客时，他只用手掌便断了雷老虎的生机，但《狂虎刀》的霸道刀意一直在脑海中盘旋，急需宣泄。

    “铮——”

    长刀出鞘。

    陈然闭上眼睛，周身气血如江河奔涌。

    七品锻骨境的强悍肉身，配合体内深厚的内力，轰然爆发。

    他单手握刀，向前一劈。

    没有花里胡哨的招式。

    只有快到极致的一记竖斩。

    空气中发出一声极其低沉的“嗡”鸣，宛如深山老林中饿虎的一声压抑低吼。

    然而。

    “咔嚓——”

    刺耳的碎裂声在寂静的屋内响起。

    陈然睁开眼，眉头微皱。

    手中的精铁腰刀，从刀尖到刀柄，布满了细密的蜘蛛网状裂纹。

    下一秒。

    “哗啦啦……”

    整把刀化作数十块碎铁片，掉落一地。只剩下一个光秃秃的刀柄握在手里。

    “凡铁终究是凡铁，承受不住七品武者的内力灌注，更别提狂虎刀法这种刚猛霸道的武学了。”

    陈然随手将刀柄扔在桌上。

    他叹了口气。

    “看来得想办法弄把好刀了，总不能每次遇到硬茬子都用巴掌去拍，容易弄脏衣服。”

    他弯下腰，将地上的碎铁片一片片捡起，仔细用破布包好，打算明天找个机会扔进天牢深处的化尸池里。

    苟道中人，绝不留下任何惹人怀疑的痕迹。

    ……

    次日清晨。

    丙字号通道内气氛肃杀。

    两具狱卒的尸体和那名黑衣杀手的尸体已经被运走。但空气中依然残留着浓重的血腥味。

    李长风穿着一身崭新的校尉武袍，面色阴沉地站在过道中央。他身边，还站着两名镇魔司的玄衣百户，浑身煞气惊人。

    陈然低着头，混在十几个战战兢兢的狱卒中间，身体恰到好处地微微发抖。

    “昨夜，有刺客潜入天牢，杀了我们两个兄弟，还灭口了重犯雷老虎。”

    李长风目光锐利，扫过众人。“我不希望这事跟咱们的人有关。”

    全场死寂。

    一名玄衣百户冷哼一声，上前一步。

    强大的气势瞬间笼罩全场，几个胆小的狱卒吓得直接瘫软在地。

    陈然眯起眼睛，气息内敛。

    在这些高手眼中，他就是一个普普通通、修为连九品都没稳固的废物狱卒。
content_en:
In the dead of night, the jailer's lounge is in the sky.

    The dim yellow oil lamp swayed, and Chen Ran's slender shadow was reflected on the wall.

    [Sit in Tianlao and gain one year of skill. 】

    The familiar warm current travels through the limbs and bones and merges into the Dantian. Chen Ran didn't pay attention to this mosquito leg. He pulled out a fine iron waist knife that was standard for the jailer from under the bed.

    When he killed the assassin in black yesterday, he cut off Thunder Tiger's life with just his palms, but the domineering intent of the "Crazy Tiger Sword" kept lingering in his mind, and he was in urgent need of venting.

    "Zheng——"

    The long sword is unsheathed.

    Chen Ran closed his eyes, and the energy and blood all over his body surged like a river.

    The powerful body of the seventh-level bone forging realm, combined with the deep internal force in the body, exploded.

    He held the knife with one hand and slashed forward.

    No fancy moves.

    There was only one extremely fast vertical slash.

    An extremely low "buzz" sounded in the air, like the muffled roar of a hungry tiger deep in the mountains and forests.

    However.

    "Click——"

    A harsh cracking sound resounded in the silent room.

    Chen Ran opened his eyes and frowned slightly.

    The fine iron waist knife in his hand is covered with fine spider web-like cracks from the tip to the handle.

    The next second.

    "Crash..."

    The entire knife turned into dozens of broken pieces of iron and fell to the ground. Only the bare handle of the knife was left in his hand.

    "Fan Tie is still Fang Tie after all. He cannot withstand the infusion of internal energy from a seventh-grade warrior, let alone a fierce and domineering martial art like the Crazy Tiger Sword Technique."

    Chen Ran casually threw the handle of the knife on the table.

    He sighed.

    "It seems that we have to find a way to get a good knife. We can't just slap it with the palm of our hands every time we encounter something tough. It will easily stain our clothes."

    He bent down and picked up the scraps of iron on the ground one by one, carefully wrapped them in rags, and planned to find an opportunity tomorrow and throw them into the corpse pool deep in the prison.

    A true believer will never leave any trace that could arouse suspicion.

    …

    Early next morning.

    The atmosphere in Channel C was solemn.

    The bodies of the two jailers and the black-clad killer have been taken away. But the strong smell of blood still lingers in the air.

    Li Changfeng was wearing a brand-new military robe of a school captain and stood in the middle of the aisle with a gloomy expression. Next to him, there were two Xuanyi Baihu from the Demon Suppressing Division, their bodies filled with astonishing evil aura.

    Chen Ran lowered his head and mingled among a dozen trembling jailers, his body trembling just right.

    "Last night, an assassin sneaked into the prison and killed two of our brothers. He also silenced the repeat offender Lei Hu."

    Li Changfeng's sharp eyes swept over everyone. "I don't want this to have anything to do with our people."

    The whole place was dead silent.

    A member of Xuanyi Baihu snorted coldly and took a step forward.

    A powerful momentum instantly enveloped the entire audience, and several timid jailers collapsed to the ground in fear.

    Chen Ran narrowed his eyes and kept his breath restrained.

    In the eyes of these masters, he is just an ordinary useless jailer whose cultivation level is not even stable at the ninth level.
